scope: New search for lower-cost translators. Source/code reviewed; no installation, no third-party model invocation.

candidate_decisions.name: Hy-MT2 translator skill
candidate_decisions.useful: Compact context, style and terminology modes, structured output.
candidate_decisions.decision: Do not install: would replace user-requested Terra/Luna with Tencent endpoint; cloud credentials or selfhosted model required. Broad ALLtranslationrequests routing not adopted. Model-specific claims do not prove a prompt works on Terra/Luna.

candidate_decisions.name: EN-RU terminology retrieval
candidate_decisions.useful: Term extraction, meaning/domain disambiguation, source-linked glossary handoff for smaller models.
candidate_decisions.decision: Test as compact source-derived brief; no bulk domain KB injected into fiction; literature evidence absent.

candidate_decisions.name: MAPS
candidate_decisions.useful: Source-topic/keywords/preparatory knowledge selection before cheap translation.
candidate_decisions.decision: Adapt only short evidence-linked handoff. Not a faithful fullMAPSreplication, no claim that role labels establish quality.

candidate_decisions.name: Chain-of-Dictionary
candidate_decisions.useful: Sense-oriented lexical support for translation limitations.
candidate_decisions.decision: Keep as research reference. NoverifiedEN-RUliteraryorTerra/Lunapromptresult; not add noisy multilingualchains inthispilot.

prior_trial_diagnosis: All conditions previously generated or edited with gpt-6.1-sol; no measurement of weaker-model lift.
Strong source-based ordinary editing was the control; this tested marginal specialist instructions, not economically useful first-pass guidance.
No raw/dollar-equivalent quality-cost frontier or actual paid escalation.
Most natural gains were rare; no statistical failure is a proof of no benefit on weak models.
Broad A/B preference obscured source-grounded categories and uncertainty; new audit separates semantic/form and Russian/voice.
